And the King of Kings commanded

And in the year 1580
of the Greeks [1269 AD],
in Nisan, at the first hour of the night of Wednesday, a violent earthquake occurred in Cilicia,
and it destroyed the fortress of Kefa of Sarwand,
and that of Emmaus,
and that of Kefa Harukhta (the split rock),
and the great monastery of the Armenians, that of the King's Oak (Balut Malka).
And about eight thousand souls perished in this earthquake.
And in Tammuz, Lord Leo, the king's son, went with rewards to make obeisance to the King of Kings,
and he was received well,
and permission was granted to him to administer the kingdom of his father.
And in the year 1581
[1270 AD], the Lord of Egypt went out to Palestine,
and he encamped against the fortress of the Kurds (Hisn al-Akrad / Krak des Chevaliers) in person,
and took it by the sword.
However, he did not kill anyone in it,
but whoever wished to stay in it he allowed to stay,
and whoever wished to depart, he sent in peace to Tripoli.
And in the year
[1271 AD], in the autumn season,
Hethum, the faithful king, passed away from an evil abscess that broke out on his chest.
And in the same year, the chief priests and the nobles gathered in the city of Tarsus,
and they placed the crown on his son Leo,
and proclaimed him king on the feast day of the Epiphany.
And during the days of the beginning of the Fast,
the Ismailis (Assassins) attacked Ala al-Din, the master of the divan (Sahib al-Diwan), in Baghdad while he was riding,
and struck him with knives,
but they did not harm him.
And they were seized, and their limbs were cut off.
And the Arabs spread a rumor
saying that they were Christians,
and had been sent by the Catholicos.
And the bishops, monks, and leaders of Baghdad were seized and imprisoned,
and also the Catholicos and his bishops were seized and imprisoned by Qutlugh Bey the Emir in Erbil.
And they were in great distress throughout the whole Fast,
until God helped,
and a command came from the Ordo, and they were liberated.
And from then on the Catholicos went and settled in the city of Ushnu in Azerbaijan.
And in the year 1583 [1272 AD],
the Greek nobles of Cilicia acted deceitfully against the new king, Leo.
And when their deceit was perceived,
they seized their Grand Baron.
